'''The Greenwell''' was part of the [[Bakur Memorial Building]] in [[Salis D'aar/Legends|Salis D'aar]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bakura/Legends|Bakura]]. It was a large arboretum filled with [[fern-tree]]s and [["Passion-bud" vine|"passion-bud" vines]]. A central fountain was located in a clearing, with [[Water/Legends|water]] leaping from [[sonic motivator]]s to create a decorative pattern of [[Gravity/Legends|gravity]] defying whirls and eddies.
